fieldValues.title: Affirm meaning over arrangement
fieldValues.decision_question: Do we fix an arrangement first, or affirm meaning first?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner's walk of 2026-10-11 after session srs-programme#100; awaiting ratification.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Affirmed meaning is preferred over fixed arrangement, unless the order is itself the meaning.
fieldValues.rationale: Ratifies the method principle Affirmed meaning over fixed arrangement rather than restating it; the principle is the standing record and is held in the Suggestions layer until the owner affirms it.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When the unless-case fires repeatedly, or an arrangement is fixed with no named meaning behind it.
